name: Move an agent to another host
note: For portable agents on plain machines, or Kubernetes without replicated storage.

steps.label: Release{agent}
steps.say: The same release used for sleeping.

steps.label: Released{session_id}
steps.say: The CLI has ended; the home is quiet.

steps.label: push home (git bundle, .k2/, provider dir)
steps.say: Content-addressed, so unchanged files cost nothing. The provider dir holds MEMORY.md and the transcripts.

steps.label: placement.epoch += 1
steps.say: The old host's claim is now stale (I1 and I4).

steps.label: Spawn{agent, home_ref, epoch}
steps.say: The new host gets a pointer to the home.

steps.label: fetch home
steps.say: On Kubernetes with replicated storage, steps 3 and 6 become a volume reattach instead.

steps.label: Ready
steps.say: The runner then checks memory files and the session id byte for byte (I3).
